text:
incident-bot: PROD alert: spike in 5xxs on /v1/embeddings in eu-west-1 at ~09:02 UTC. Detected automatic fallback to variant 'chat-instruct-v1' for alias acct-embed; many requests returning 500s after the fallback. Auto-page oncall. link: https://internal/incidents/2750001111 :rotating_light:

maria: oncall here, acked. seeing the same in Grafana — embeddings p95 latency + errors. looking at routing logs now.

sam: digging into router logs — one of the recent alias updates added a pinned version mapping for acct-embed to v2.4.9-chat-instruct (should've been v2.4.9-embed). fallback policy is configured to route to chat variants if primary fails. that explains the incompatible fallback.

jen: wait — we explicitly have safeguards to prevent chat variants for embedding routes, how did the pin slip through?

dave: ops-rollout job confirmed a config push 09:00 by infra-bot that updated alias -> version mapping. change was authored by a config-scripts PR that munged the variant label. appears to be human/config tooling error.

sam: copying a snippet from the affected alias config (sanitized):

```json
{
  "alias": "acct-embed",
  "pinned_version": "v2.4.9-chat-instruct",
  "fallback_policy": ["chat-instruct-v1", "instruct-v2"]
}
```

maria: that pinned version is incompatible with the /embeddings path — runtime rejects with type error -> 500. Immediate mitigation: remove the pin or force-route embeddings to the correct embed variant.

jen: agree. what's the safest fast path? rollback the alias to previous mapping, or temporarily disable fallback for this alias?

sam: I can unpin the alias via the control plane API. unpin will let routing pick model by interface (embed). doing that now. command: 

`curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/aliases/unpin -H 'Authorization: Bearer **REDACTED**' -d '{"alias":"acct-embed"}'`

ops-bot: executed unpin action (job id job-8753).

pagerduty-bot: paging maria (oncall) and sam (sre) for followup — incident severity elevated to Sev2 due to customer-impacting embedding failures.

maria: verified via router logs: unpin accepted, alias mapping reverted to v2.4.8-embed-stable. I’m forcing a route flush on eu-west-1 so cached decisions don't keep routing to chat.

sam: flushed caches: `controlplane route flush --region eu-west-1 --alias acct-embed` — returning success. observing a drop in 5xxs in metrics now.

carol: product here — we have 3 paying customers in eu-west-1 reporting degraded embeddings in the last 15m (tickets #INC-4431, #INC-4432, #INC-4433). can we confirm scope and send an initial customer update?

maria: initial impact window ~09:00–09:12 UTC, estimated ~2.4k requests failed. affected orgs: acct-phi, acct-ml, acct-search. I'll draft a short incident message once we stabilize.

jen: next steps: 1) block chat variants from being pinned to embedding aliases via validation in config-scripts (short-term gate), 2) add a canary check in the alias rollout to reject incompatible variant labels, 3) postmortem and owner assignment.

sam: adding mitigation task: temporarily disable fallback for embedding interface globally until we push the config validation patch. command to add override: 

```yaml
route_overrides:
  interface: embedding
  allow_fallback: false
```

maria: applied the override for eu-west-1 (deploy id override-2026-03-15-09:10). monitoring. error rate back to baseline in last 60s.

dave: nice catch. I'll revert the rollout job that pushed the bad mapping and follow up with the infra team to fix the templating bug. also opening a postmortem draft (internal link: https://docs.internal/postmortems/2750001111).

carol: I've sent an interim customer-facing note: "We're investigating intermittent embedding failures in EU with degraded performance from 09:00–09:12 UTC. We have restored correct routing and are monitoring. We'll follow up with details."

maria: leaving oncall to sam in 10m but will stay on incident until we see stable metrics. handoff: sam (sre) now on primary.

sam: ack, taking over. I've instrumented a short-lived alert to catch any reappearance. also running a quick scan for other aliases that have chat variants incorrectly pinned to embed interfaces.

ops-bot: background job scan found 2 other aliases with suspicious variant labels in staging; flagged for manual review.

sam: assigning follow-up tickets: INFRA-912 (fix templating), ROUTE-431 (prevent chat pins on embed aliases), POSTMORTEM-2750001111.

maria: thanks all. closing the active pager once we confirm 30m stable. will add timeline and customer impact to the postmortem. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident update: unpin + route flush applied, fallback override enabled, error rate recovered to baseline. Severity downgraded to Sev3.

sam: marking incident as mitigated. full postmortem to include: root cause (config templating bug allowed chat variant to be pinned to embedding alias), blast radius, immediate mitigations, and permanent fixes (validation + rollout gate). owner: dave + sam.

carol: will coordinate customer communications after the postmortem draft.

maria: signing off from active oncall. leaving notes in the incident doc.

-- end of thread --
